title: A pass claim cites its verdict line; checks run only through verdict
why: R20, owner 18:36 CST Nov 10 ("yes"), relayed by the retrospective session, after a session misread its own echo exit code as lane lint passes (owner shared 17:17 CST). (1) A "passed", "green" or "clean" claim in a report or a message to a parent cites a verdict line from this session's verdict log; the report guard refuses an uncited claim, remedy "run it through verdict". (2) Lint, ci-job, tests and the merge tool's release check run only through verdict; a bare run is refused with that form. Rule tokens-run-through-verdict has no enforcer on main today. Both inside existing guards, no new process. Homes: CLAUDE.md tokens-run-through-verdict; decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner. Plan stage 3.6, commit 9918ceb.
